Whisk Crêpes Café

Oak Cliff, Dallas

Whisk Crêpes Café has been a Dallas favorite since 2009.

Julien hosted underground dinners for 20 to 100 guests while living in Paris.
His early career with Air France in business management took him to Nigeria, Peru and other parts of the world, but he found the comforts of Dallas synonymous to the comfort and early childhood memories of homemade crêpes with grandma.

Guests consistently describe us as a 5-star dining experience.

Loved by more than 3,000 five-star reviews across Dallas.

The café's wooden tables were hand-selected by Julien from a reclaimed barn in East Texas.
